senses.definition: (reflexive pronoun) Her; the female object of a verb or preposition that also appears as the subject.

quotes.text: This time was most dreadful for Lilian. Thrown on her own resources and almost penniless, she maintained herself and paid the rent of a wretched room near the hospital by working as a charwoman, sempstress, anything. In a moment she had dropped to the level of a casual labourer.

senses.definition: (emphatic) She; an intensifier of the female subject or object, often used to indicate the directness or exclusiveness of that person .
(Ireland) The subject or non-reflexive object of a predicate; she (used of upper-class ladies, or sarcastically, of women who imagine themselves to be more important than others)
examples: What's herself up to this time?
Have you seen herself yet this morning?

quotes.text: Was anyone hurted? Sure, they were just trailin' theirselves off the ground. Ye wud have died larfin'. There's Jimmy Hanlon was never his own man since, and I had me nose broke on me—I find it yet—and some says there was a wee girl from Tanderagee got herself killed.
